# Enforce credential version in dashboard sessions and admin password reset

## Summary

Extend Hermes dashboard auth so every session cookie carries the user’s current `credentialVersion`, and `resolveHermesActiveAdminDashboardAccess` rejects stale cookies. Increment the version whenever an admin’s password is changed via the existing logged-in admin reset flow so behavior matches the future self-service path.

## Scope

- In scope: `auth-user` payload and login persistence (`createPersistAdminSession` / equivalents); `resolveHermesActiveAdminDashboardAccess` (and any shared session gate); `createResetAdminPasswordHandler` path to bump version after bcrypt update; treat missing version in cookie as 0 for migration.
- Out of scope: Self-service reset completion (TICKET-004); forgot-password email (TICKET-003).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Successful login writes `credentialVersion` from DB into the session cookie payload alongside id, name, email.
- [ ] Dashboard access resolution compares cookie `credentialVersion` to `User.credentialVersion` in DB; mismatch yields unauthenticated / no access (same as invalid session).
- [ ] After a logged-in admin resets another admin’s password via the existing reset-password route, the target user’s `credentialVersion` increments (or equivalent), so any of their old browser sessions stop working on next navigation.
- [ ] Automated tests cover: login sets version; stale version denied; admin reset bumps target version and invalidates their prior session semantics.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: TICKET-001
- Blocks: TICKET-004

## Notes

Reference files from PRD: `apps/hermes/dashboard/lib/auth-dashboard.ts`, `apps/hermes/dashboard/app/login/action/route.post.config.ts`, `apps/hermes/dashboard/app/dashboard/admins/actions/reset-password/route.post.config.ts`.
